description: Kerala includes Artificial Intelligence (AI) in school textbooks.
body_lead: Results for " Kerala includes Artificial Intelligence (AI) in school textbooks. With the introduction of AI learning in the Information & Communication Technology ( ICT ) textbook of Class 7, over 4 lakh students in Kerala will become familiar with AI in the upcoming academic year. One of the activities in the 'Computer Vision' chapter will involve students creating their own AI program that can recognize human facial expressions. This program will identify up to seven emotions on a person's face.
